name: Ellie Confidential
source:
Ellie has always dreamed of becoming a police officer, and she is determined to make it work. As a recent graduate, you will have to work hard and navigate department politics, but you have a long and colorful career ahead of you. Become a detective, clear cases, meet old and new faces inside and outside the department.

But be careful: You can never be sure who someone really is behind closed doors - and danger lurks everywhere. Loyalty can sometimes be dangerous, hold you back - or keep you alive. Choose carefully!​

[From F95zone]
